conclusion.details: /NDPACK places initialized data in PACK and static uninitialized data in PACK_BSS, and emits DS-based indexed references for near globals. It emits an unconditional prologue loading DS through a segment relocation to PACK (even for the no-global far control); target _InsertNode instead loads DS from DGROUP [B8DE], while target _InitTree has no DS save/load and begins with ES=[B8DE]. __loadds produces the same direct segment-relocation pattern; named-segment based arrays use ES and conflict with /NDPACK (C1127), and dynamic unpackHandle-based arrays use ES. No tested spelling reproduces the target selector load.
